notes: The pages do not contain a dedicated page for the Applied Economics programme; programmePage is null. Duration and teaching language are not stated in the supplied pages. The only tuition figure for Applied Economics is the non-EEA (EUR) fee of 7 000 €/year; the same table shows 1 980 000 Ft for EEA applicants. An English B2 certificate is required for this Bachelor's programme; accepted tests also include Cambridge FCE, TOEFL iBT (72), TOEIC (785), Duolingo (100), SkillCert EGP (96), A-level/IB, Hungarian advanced Matura, GCSE/IGCSE, and INTO/Study Group/Kaplan/Navitas/Corvinus Preparatory. The application platform is DreamApply, which is not one of the allowed channel codes; hu-university-direct was chosen because the page says to apply online on the university's dedicated platform.
